title: Countable ball localization of almost-everywhere properties
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let μ be any measure on ℝ^P, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let A ⊆ U, and let Φ be any predicate on ℝ^P. Suppose that for all y ∈ ℝ^P and r ∈ ℝ with B̄_r(y) ⊆ U, Φ(x) holds for μ⌞(A ∩ B_r(y))-almost every x. Then Φ(x) holds for μ⌞A-almost every x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (U A : Set (Eucl P)) (Φ : Eucl P → Prop), IsOpen U → A ⊆ U → (∀ (y : Eucl P) (r : ℝ), closedBall y r ⊆ U → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict (A ∩ ball y r)), Φ x) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict A), Φ x
